subject: Lumina acceptance window compression / MAP reforecast request
messages:
From: Anna Wu <anna.wu@lumina.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP / acceptance window - urgent ask

Neha / Laura,

Quick context: Procurement has just surfaced a budget window closing the week of Apr 24, and executive ops wants a compressed acceptance window so they can turn on production in May. The current MAP assumes a May 20 go-live with a two-week acceptance window — they now need that acceptance condensed into 3 business days or a phased approach that lets them ship core inference first.

This is driven by a vendor consolidation deadline on their side (internal deadline) and an upcoming marketing launch. Can Redwood provide: a) a version of the MAP that supports phased acceptance (core API + embeddings first), b) a condensed remediation SLA for critical defects, and c) a proposal for commercial protection (credits / escrow) if acceptance stretches beyond the compressed window?

They can provide an expedited SOC evidence packet if you need it for the VPC checklist. I attached the MAP we have today (Lumina_MPA_v2.xlsx) and procurement's formal ask.

Next steps would need to be: updated MAP by Wed Apr 4, and a short call with procurement on Thu Apr 5. Please confirm whether Redwood can commit to the compressed window or whether we should propose a staggered cutover.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Wu
Director, Cloud Integrations
Lumina Health Systems

Attachments: Lumina_MPA_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Wu <anna.wu@lumina.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / acceptance window - urgent ask

Anna — thanks for flagging and for the clear timeline constraints. We can support Lumina on a compressed path, but there are three conditions we need to build into the MAP so we can protect both quality and economics:

1) Phased acceptance: cut over core generation + embeddings (API routes: /generate, /embed) first. Remaining routes (reranking, tool-calls) to follow in a second acceptance window within 30 days.

2) Acceptance gating and SLAs: a 3-business-day smoke acceptance for obvious regressions (latency, availability), with a 14-day remediation SLA for functional regressions tied to pre-agreed evaluation prompts. Critical P1 fixes will be triaged on an accelerated cadence.

3) Commercial protection: for a compressed acceptance window we can offer a 10% credit applied to first month of usage if faults attributable to Redwood extend acceptance beyond the 3 business days. For broader schedule slippage tied to Lumina procurement delays we need a joint exception process (MPA appendix) rather than unilateral credits.

Operational asks: please have procurement share the finalized acceptance prompt set (three canonical flows) by Wed Apr 4 EOD so we can baseline evals. Ive sketched a proposed MAP v3 (attached) that includes the phased cutover plan, acceptance gates, and the credit clause.

Proposed next steps:
- Wed Apr 4: internal Redwood PR/ops review of MAP v3
- Thu Apr 5: 30-min call with Lumina procurement to confirm acceptance prompts and final SLAs
- Fri Apr 6: shared updated MAP for signature / DocuSign

If youd like immediate escalation on credits, loop in Ben Carter (cc'd here) and I can push for a provisional approval.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_MAP_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Lumina compressed acceptance - provisional commercial ask

Ben — quick escalation from the Lumina opportunity (LUM-4239). Customer requests a compressed 3-business-day acceptance for a May production activation; Neha proposed a 10% first-month credit as protection. Were asking for provisional authorization to approve the 10% credit (applied as a usage credit) if the acceptance slips due to Redwood defect.

Rationale: the customer is moving up their marketing activation and will otherwise delay the entire go-live. Approving a limited first-month credit significantly reduces friction and preserves the timeline (and ARR). If procurement pushes for deeper concession wed revert to leadership for approval.

Requested action: provisional approval for 10% first-month credit, subject to the final MAP appendix and a cap of $50k. Also confirm whether finance needs a PO amendment.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Wu <anna.wu@lumina.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / acceptance window - approval and next steps

Anna — thanks for the clear ask and for working through timings with Neha. Redwood is prepared to move forward on the phased acceptance path. We approve a provisional 10% credit to be applied to Lumina's first month of billables, capped at $50,000, contingent on: 1) the MAP v3 appendix being signed and 2) the canonical prompt set being uploaded to the shared Drive by Thu Apr 5.

Operational details:
- We will provide an accelerated remediation channel (P1 triage within 4 hours) during the compressed acceptance window.
- Deployment will be staged: core inference + embeddings first, then expanded routes after acceptance of the first tranche.
- DocuSign link for the MAP v3 will be delivered by EOD Fri Apr 6.

Neha — please schedule the Thu Apr 5 call with Procurement Ops and copy finance for any PO amendment. Anna — appreciate the fast coordination.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v3-signed.pdf (application/pdf)
